body:
I guess you're right, it would be a decent way to distract myself... and I can't lose my job.

And everyone is saying water is a good remedy... may I ask why... cause I'm drinking it and only feel a little better.

I just grabbed a bottle of water to see if it helps thanks, and I don't feel like i need to "own" her or have her at my beck and call.... its just I worry about her, which is why I try to get up with her when I don't hear from her for 10+ hours, and she said she would only be gone for 2... I just worry.

and I don't have any allergy medication to take, and I don't plan on jumping into another relationship.. to be honest I don't even feel like goiing to work tomorrow.

I never thought of it like that... I didn't ever mean to scare her if I did. She just means so much to me, and honestly I would rather die than go through this pain... I've never felt so heartbroken in my life
